method:
Measure what each local run's prompt contained, by token counts.

For each model: the server-reported prompt_eval_count of the real run is compared with raw token counts
of (a) the participant text alone and (b) any candidate system prompt. Measurement calls use
/api/generate with raw=true (no template), num_predict=1; the one generated token is discarded.
These calls are not participant runs. Output: .private/round-00/render-check.json (exclusive create).
